comparison.objective: Run a fair experiment to identify the higher-friction sled and place it on a mat; candidate commissions a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Equalize mass, operate launchers, compare travel and classify a sled versus hex-key insertion, collar tuning, torque-controlled locking and interpreting stop dynamics.
comparison.success_condition: Requires both sleds launched at equal total mass, neither hitting the end wall, correct friction inference and selection; candidate requires prescribed impact energy/velocity and two repeatable safe stops after physical relocking.
comparison.reason: Both use repeated dynamics and observed motion, but one tests experimental control and material inference while the candidate tests mechanical adjustment and retention.
